components.content:
Section 12: Supporting Documentation Information

Check all documents that you are including with this application and upload the files. Required documents vary based on your specialty type and circumstances.
NOTE: The CMS-855R (Reassignment of Medicare Benefits) form has been discontinued. All reassignment actions are reported in Section 4F of this application.

components.label: Copy(s) of all final adverse legal action documentation (e.g., notifications, resolutions, and reinstatement letters) (Shows new form) ◿
components.description: Include if you answered 'Yes' to Section 3C, 4A2, or 6B

components.label: Upload Final Adverse Legal Action Documentation
Completed Form CMS-460, Medicare Participating Physician or Supplier Agreement (Shows new form) ◿
Completed Form CMS-588, Electronic Funds Transfer Authorization Agreement (include a voided check or bank letter) (Shows new form) ◿
components.description: NOTE: If you currently receive payments electronically and are not making a change to your banking information, the CMS-588 is not required.

components.label: Upload CMS-588 Form and Voided Check/Bank Letter
Written statement regarding a lending relationship with the financial institution receiving Medicare payments (Shows new form) ◿
components.description: Required if Medicare payments due to you are being sent to a bank (or similar financial institution) where you have a lending relationship (that is, any type of loan)

components.label: Written confirmation from the IRS confirming your Tax Identification Number and Legal Business Name provided in Section 4A (e.g., IRS Form CP-575) (Shows new form) ◿
components.description: NOTE: This is only required if you reported a Legal Business Name and TIN in Section 4A.

components.label: Upload IRS TIN/Legal Business Name Confirmation

Written confirmation from the IRS if your business is registered as a Limited Liability Company (LLC), including single member LLCs, confirming your LLC is authorized to use the reported TIN (Shows new form) ◿
Copy of IRS Determination Letter if you are registered with the IRS as non-profit (e.g., IRS Form 501(c)(3)) (Shows new form) ◿
components.description: NOTE: Government-owned entities do not need to submit this documentation.

components.label: Current copy of certification and proof of educational requirements for eligible professionals or other non-physician specialty types who provide acupuncture services (Shows new form) ◿
Upload Acupuncture Certification and Educational Documentation
